venues.name: Alliant Energy PowerHouse

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: The Box Office can be contacted at (319) 362-1729.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Box Office is open Monday through Friday 10:00 AM-6:00 PM*. Weekends only on event or on-sale days beginning at 10:00 am *Summer hours Memorial Day through Labor Day are 10:00 AM-4:30 PM
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts Cash, Visa, MasterCard, and Discover Card.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call Tickets may be picked up at the Will Call Window at the main entrance of the facility no earlier than 90 minutes before the performance. General Admission tickets may be picked up 3 hours prior to showtime. Customers must have the actual credit card used for the order, a picture ID, and the confirmation number to receive their tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available near the facility. The Five Seasons Parkade located at 400 1st Ave SE connects to the Alliant Energy PowerHouse via skywalk. A satellite Box Office window will also be available in the Five Seasons Parkade skywalk on event days only beginning two hours prior. Additional ramps are located on 3rd Ave & 4th Ave.

generalInfo.generalRule: Professional cameras and audio/video recording devices are not allowed into the facility. No outside food or beverages. Smoking is not permitted.
generalInfo.childRule: Minimum age requirements on paid tickets will vary by show. Please call the Alliant Energy PowerHouse Box Office for event specific details.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Box Office is open only on the day of an event, opening two hours prior to showtime. Tickets for events held at the Paramount Theatre may be purchased in advance at the U.S. Cellular Center ticket office.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover Card, Cash and Checks.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets may be picked up no earlier than 90 minutes prior to showtime in the theatre lobby. Customers must present the actual credit card used for the order, a picture ID, and the confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: There is a lot located 1/2 block from the Theatre. Street parking is also available.

generalInfo.generalRule: Cameras and recording devices are not allowed in the facility.
generalInfo.childRule: Children under 2 years of age are admitted free if held on a ticket holders lap.
